name: TinyUSB Keyboard
description: The `tinyusb_keyboard` component makes the device appear to a USB host as a keyboard with media keys, built on [TinyUSB](https://esphome.io/components/tinyusb/). Actions press and release keys, so a button, a sensor or any other automation can type on the connected computer or control its volume and playback.
